channel.title: MediaToday Co Ltd - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from MediaToday Co Ltd (maltatoday.com.mt)

item.title: Prime minister urges standards czar to investigate time-barred allegations against him
item.description: Prime Minister Robert Abela is facing calls for investigation over allegations levelled against him by Judge Lawrence Mintoff

item.title: Judge Lawrence Mintoff will not resign, people close to him say
item.description: Judge Lawrence Mintoff will be investigated by the Commissioner for Judicial Standards Toni Abela after the chief justice files complaint • People close to the judge say ‘he will not resign’

item.title: Accused burnt ear, bit hand of his partner in domestic violence row
item.description: Accused man facing domestic violence charges had in December extinguished cigarette on victim’s ear and bit her hand, court hears • Accused has eight-month-old child with victim

item.title: Social benefits fail to guarantee ‘dignified standard of living’, NAO says
item.description: Audit finds families relying solely on non-contributory benefits face a €4,600 shortfall

item.title: Behind The Mask: Malta Carnival exhibited at EU Parliament
item.description: A combination of history and artistry of costume design, and hand-crafted props made by enthusiasts and volunteers, was exhibited at the European Parliament for the first time.

item.title: Man who threatened to shoot cellmate’s family during fight has sentence confirmed on appeal
item.description: Court of Criminal Appeal upholds conviction of inmate for threatening fellow prisoner at Corradino Correctional Facility, noting his extensive criminal record and rejecting claims that the sentence was excessive

item.title: MIDI agrees to transfer T15 Building at Tigné Point for €5.5 million
item.description: MIDI p.l.c. enters into a promise of sale agreement for the transfer of the T15 Building at Tigné Point for €5.5 million • Sale covers remaining period of a 99-year temporary emphyteusis that commenced on 15 June 2000

item.title: What happens to the cash and drugs confiscated from criminals?
item.description: We’ve seen the police photos of packets of drugs and wads of cash confiscated during a raid on a criminal’s den. But what happens to the booty once criminal procedures are over? Karl Azzopardi finds out

item.title: Maid’s Bedroom golf ‘obstacle’ at Marsa course set for restoration
item.description: A planning application has been submitted by the Royal Malta Golf Club for the restoration of a limestone ruin located on the sixth hole of the golf course
